sources.text: 量子位 - GPT Image 2.5现身：升级弹窗+LMArena匿名模型，社区实测能伪造GPT-6发布会照片

body_html:
朋友们，今天的瓜是套娃结构，我一层一层剥给你们看。

第一层：GPT Image 2.5，没发布。OpenAI官方一个字都没说，独立英文信源也确认没有官方公告。但ChatGPT里出现了升级弹窗，LMArena上冒出一个代号luna-lisa-alpha的匿名图像模型，社区一测，普遍猜就是它。第二层：这个"还没发布"的模型，已经能伪造GPT-6发布会的现场照片，连奥特曼的手写信都仿得以假乱真。你品，你细品——一个还没出道的图像模型，最出圈的作品，是给自己家的旗舰模型造假。

先说公道话：进步是真实的

测试口径下，这次升级确实能打：相比GPT Image 2，噪点明显改善；出图更快；人脸稳定了不少；最要命的是图像内的文字嵌入也稳了。懂行的都知道，以前AI画招牌，十张里九张是鬼画符；文字一稳，伪造"现场照片"的最后一道技术门槛就被踏平了——传单、证书、发布会大屏截图，从此都能以假乱真。

槽点不在技术，在形状

真正的槽点：这批伪造的GPT-6发布会照片，是顺着AI新闻的信源链传播的。上游看到"高清现场图"，转发；下游看到上游发了，跟着转。AI生成的内容，污染AI新闻的信源——闭环了，套娃了。更讽刺的是，英文独立信源此刻还在忙着辟谣"GPT Image 2.5没发布"，辟谣文本身又成了新信源，套娃再+1。眼见为实？在图像模型把文字都画稳之后，这句话正式作废。

所以本栏目从今天起立个新规矩，也建议你立：凡是"现场照片"，先问出处，再谈转发——尤其是AI圈的现场照片，造假的技术永远比验证的习惯跑得快。

今天就槽到这里，明天继续。
body_html_en:
Friends, today's melon comes in nesting dolls. Let me peel them one by one.

Layer one: GPT Image 2.5 — not released. OpenAI has said nothing officially, and independent English-language sources confirm no announcement. Yet ChatGPT shows an upgrade pop-up, and LMArena has an anonymous image model codenamed luna-lisa-alpha; the community's consensus guess is that it's the one. Layer two: this "unreleased" model can already fake GPT-6 keynote photos, down to a handwritten letter from Sam Altman. Savor that: an image model that hasn't even debuted, whose most viral work is forging its own family's flagship.

Fairness first: the progress is real

In hands-on testing, this upgrade genuinely delivers: far less noise than GPT Image 2, faster rendering, steadier faces — and, most crucially, stable text inside images. Connoisseurs know the old gag: nine out of ten AI-drawn storefront signs were gibberish. With text stabilized, the last technical barrier to fake "on-site photos" — flyers, certificates, keynote screen captures — has been flattened.

The problem isn't the tech; it's the shape

The real gripe: those fake GPT-6 keynote photos traveled along AI news' own supply chain. Upstream sees "high-res on-site shots," shares; downstream sees upstream, follows. AI-generated content polluting AI news sources — loop closed, dolls nested. More ironic still: independent English sources are busy debunking "GPT Image 2.5 isn't out," and the debunkings become new sources themselves — one more doll. Seeing is believing? Now that image models draw stable text, the phrase is officially retired.

So this column sets a new rule today, and you should too: for any "on-site photo," check provenance before you share — especially in AI, where forgery always outruns verification habits.

That's all for today's rant — more tomorrow.
footnote_tip: 实用提醒：1. 看到"发布会现场照片"先找官方视频或状态页比对，转发前多问一句出处；2. 判断"模型是否发布"，以官方渠道为准——升级弹窗、竞技场匿名模型都是线索而非结论；3. 图像内文字已能画稳的时代，"有图有真相"请自动降级为"有图待核实"。
footnote_tip_en: Practical tips: 1. For any "keynote photo," compare against the official video or status page and ask for provenance before sharing; 2. To judge whether a model is actually released, rely on official channels — upgrade pop-ups and Arena anonymous models are clues, not conclusions; 3. In an era where AI renders stable text in images, auto-downgrade "a picture is worth a thousand words" to "a picture pending verification."
